title.purpose: Side panel product name (16px) and chat header title (15px). No display role exists.

claim.purpose: One-line statement directly above a proof frame; reading/sending status lines.

body.purpose: Explanatory copy and chat paragraphs; field labels at 500.

label.purpose: Proof-row labels and tabular figures; side panel section headings at 600 in muted grey.

caption.purpose: Hints, sources line, chat mode/date line, proof-row detail, footer.

shadows.name: float

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Focused text inputs, paired with an accent border.

motion.name: ease

motion.name: rise

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one forward action in a section (Read the tool, Open chat on this page, Send).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-accent, #3b5bdb); color: #fff; font: 600 14px/1.5 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent-hover, #2f4bc0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #3b5bdb); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: default; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Repeat or alternative actions (Read again, Stop, Open Foresight).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong, #d4d4d4); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); font: 500 14px/1.5 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-page, #fafafa); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #3b5bdb); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; }

components.name: Text Link Button
components.css: .ds-link { border: 0; background: none; padding: 0; color: var(--color-ink-2, #3d3d3d); font: 400 14px/1.5 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--color-line-strong, #d4d4d4); text-underline-offset: 2px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-link:hover { color: var(--color-accent, #3b5bdb); text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #3b5bdb); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Settings fields and the chat compose input.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line-strong, #d4d4d4); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); font: 400 14px/1.5 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; caret-color: var(--color-accent, #3b5bdb); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted, #6b6b6b); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-accent, #3b5bdb); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(59,91,219,0.15); }

components.name: Claim and Proof Frame
components.description: Signature: a semibold claim followed by hairline-framed rows, label left, figure right; alert figures in semibold red.
components.html:
2 people over-allocated next week:

  • Felix D.135%
  • Mei D.120%
  • Pages read14
components.css: .ds-answer { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font: 400 14px/1.5 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); } .ds-claim { margin: 0; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-proof { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; background: var(--color-page, #fafafa); border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #e8e8e8); border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13px; } .ds-proof li { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line, #e8e8e8); } .ds-proof li:first-child { border-top: 0; } .ds-l { color: var(--color-ink-2, #3d3d3d); } .ds-v { text-align: right; color: var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-v.ds-alert { color: var(--color-danger, #b42318); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Side Panel Section
components.description: Hairline-topped block with a muted sentence-case heading.
components.css: .ds-section { padding: 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line, #e8e8e8); background: var(--color-surface, #fff); font: 400 14px/1.5 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink, #0a0a0a); } .ds-section h2 { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-muted, #6b6b6b); } .ds-section p { margin: 0; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Chat Launcher
components.description: Ink pill that opens the floating chat on Foresight pages.
components.html: <button class="ds-launcher"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 4.5h12a1.5 1.5 0 0 1 1.5 1.5v7a1.5 1.5 0 0 1-1.5 1.5H9l-4 3v-3H4A1.5 1.5 0 0 1 2.5 13V6A1.5 1.5 0 0 1 4 4.5Z"/></svg> Ask</button>
components.css: .ds-launcher { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 18px 0 14px; border: 1px solid #0a0a0a; border-radius: 22px; background: #0a0a0a; color: #fff; font: 600 14px/1.5 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(10,10,10,0.10), 0 2px 6px rgba(10,10,10,0.06); transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-launcher:hover { background: #262626; } .ds-launcher:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-launcher:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3b5bdb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Suggestion Chip
components.description: Starter questions in an empty chat.
components.css: .ds-suggest { text-align: left; padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid #e8e8e8; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #3d3d3d; font: 400 14px/1.5 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 120ms, background 120ms; } .ds-suggest:hover { border-color: #d4d4d4; background: #fafafa; color: #0a0a0a; } .ds-suggest:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3b5bdb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Error Notice
components.html: The assistant server didn't accept the data. Check it is running, then read again.
components.css: .ds-error { margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-danger-bg, #fef3f2); color: var(--color-danger, #b42318); font: 400 13px/1.5 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
A quiet, near-colourless working tool whose one recurring gesture is evidence. Every summary, answer and warning list is a short claim in semibold followed directly by a hairline-framed block of rows: label on the left, figure on the right. The frame is the system's signature; everything else steps back so it reads first.

Density is moderate and calm: one system sans at regular and semibold, sentence case throughout, tabular numerals in every figure. Surfaces are white on a faint grey page, separated by 1px rules rather than shadows. Colour is spent sparingly: a single blue for the one primary action and focus, red only for states that are genuinely wrong (over-allocated, overdue, errors), amber only for "check this" notices.

The same world runs on two surfaces: the extension side panel (Tailwind v4 theme tokens) and the floating chat, which lives in a shadow root on the host page and re-declares the same values as custom properties.
keyCharacteristics: Claim, then proof frame, for every answer, summary and warning list.
Neutral greyscale from #fafafa to #0a0a0a; one blue accent; red and amber reserved for state.
Hairline rules (1px #e8e8e8) do the structural work; shadow only where the chat floats over a foreign page.
One system sans, two working weights, sentence case, tabular numerals.
Gently rounded rectangles (8px) for every control and frame.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue marks the one action that moves the user forward and the element that has focus. A section never has two blue buttons; once data exists, "Read again" drops to secondary.

rules.name: The State-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Red and amber appear only when a figure or message is actually wrong or incomplete, and always alongside words that say so ("over-allocated", "Stopped at the page limit"). Colour is never the only signal.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number in a proof row uses tabular numerals and is right-aligned, so columns of figures scan vertically.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings, buttons and labels are sentence case. No uppercase labels, no tracking.

rules.name: The Hairline Over Shadow Rule
rules.body: Inside a surface, structure is drawn with 1px rules. Shadow is reserved for something floating over someone else's page.

dos: **Do** follow every claim with its proof frame: hairline border, page-grey fill, label left, figure right.
**Do** keep one blue element per section: the forward action or the focused control.
**Do** pair every red or amber value with words that name the problem.
**Do** use tabular numerals and right alignment for every figure.
**Do** separate surfaces with 1px #e8e8e8 rules and the page/surface value step.
donts: **Don't** use chat bubbles; the user's question is plain right-aligned muted text and the answer is claim plus proof.
**Don't** use blue for decoration, icons or headings.
**Don't** add shadows inside a surface; shadow belongs only to the floating chat.
**Don't** use uppercase labels, eyebrows or tracked small caps above headings.
**Don't** introduce a numbered-stepper flow; the side panel is sections, not steps.
